title: CALB1 expression in meningioma: associations with progression-free survival and chromosome arm 6q loss
title_zh: CALB1 在脑膜瘤中的表达：与无进展生存期和6q染色体臂缺失的关联
abstract: Abstract Molecular profiling has refined risk stratification in meningioma, but the biological relevance of associated transcriptional changes remains incompletely understood. Calbindin D28K (Calb), encoded by CALB1 , is a calcium-binding protein with reported anti-apoptotic and cytoprotective functions. Previous unsupervised transcriptomic analysis identified CALB1 upregulation in meningiomas with aggressive cellular features, but its biological and clinical relevance remains unresolved. We analysed Calb immunoreactivity in 231 meningioma tissue microarray (TMA) cores from 147 patients and evaluated CALB1 transcript expression, DNA methylation and copy-number alterations in an independent cohort of 110 primary meningiomas. Calb immunoreactivity was detected in approximately 30% of primary tumours, and elevated CALB1 transcript levels were observed at a similar frequency in the molecular cohort. High Calb protein expression was associated with shorter progression-free survival (PFS) after adjustment for the included clinical variables in the primary cohort. This association was also observed in restricted analyses of histological WHO grade 2 meningiomas. Lower methylation of selected exonic and intronic CALB1 CpG sites correlated with a higher transcript expression, consistent with an epigenetic contribution to deregulation. Multivariable analyses identified associations of CALB1 transcript expression with chromosome arm 6q loss, histological WHO grade, CALB1 hypo-methylation and specific methylation subclasses in the secondary cohort. Differential expression analysis of tumours harbouring 6q loss identified expression differences in CALB1 and transcription factors, including NKX2-5 and SOX11 . In contrast, expression of a related calcium-binding protein Calretinin (Calr) and the Progesterone Receptor (PR) was not significantly associated with PFS in the primary cohort. Together, these findings support the potential prognostic relevance of Calb protein expression, particularly in histological WHO grade 2 meningiomas, and associate CALB1 transcript expression with selected molecular features in complementary cohorts. Calb immunohistochemistry may therefore provide a practical tool for refining risk stratification in this clinically heterogeneous tumour type prior to integrative molecular testing.
abstract_zh: 摘要 分子分型已完善脑膜瘤的风险分层，但与转录变化相关的生物学相关性仍不完全清楚。由CALB1编码的钙结合蛋白Calbindin D28K（Calb）具有报告的抗凋亡和细胞保护功能。先前的无监督转录组分析在具有侵袭性细胞特征的脑膜瘤中鉴定出CALB1的上调，但其生物学和临床相关性仍未解决。我们在来自147例患者的231个脑膜瘤组织组织微阵列（TMA）芯片上分析了Calb免疫反应性，并评估了110例原发性脑膜瘤独立队列中的CALB1转录本表达、DNA甲基化和拷贝数变异。在约30%的原发性肿瘤中检测到Calb免疫反应性，在分子队列中以相似频率观察到升高的CALB1转录本水平。经调整临床变量后，高Calb蛋白表达与原发队列中较短的无进展生存期（PFS）相关。在限定为组织学WHO II级脑膜瘤的亚组分析中也观察到了这种关联。所选CALB1外显子和内含子CpG位点的低甲基化与较高的转录本表达相关，这与表观遗传失调的贡献一致。多变量分析确定了CALB1转录本表达与6q染色体臂缺失、组织学WHO grade、CALB1低甲基化以及次级队列中特定甲基化亚类之间的关联。携带6q缺失的肿瘤的差异表达分析确定了CALB1和转录因子（包括NKX2-5和SOX11）的表达差异。相比之下，相关钙结合蛋白Calretinin（Calr）和孕酮受体（PR）的表达在原发队列中与PFS无显著关联。总的来说，这些发现支持Calb蛋白表达的潜在预后相关性，特别是在组织学WHO II级脑膜瘤中，并将CALB1转录本表达与互补队列中的选定分子特征联系起来。因此，Calb免疫组化可能在分子检测之前，为这种临床异质性肿瘤类型的风险分层提供一种实用工具。
